item.text:
**6B.8 Research Note: Andrés Manuel López Obrador in 2024**

**Verdict**  
Mixed, leaning negative. AMLO’s government did make real rights-based moves for Indigenous people, women, and some service delivery channels, but the 2024 record still shows persistent discrimination, unequal treatment of migrants and disabled people, and a hostile climate toward journalists and protesters. That makes the dignity/equal-opportunity case weaker than the aggregate-welfare case.

**Accepted Claims**

- [`Reforma en materia de pueblos indígenas y afromexicanos es un acto de justicia social`](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/reforma-en-materia-de-pueblos-indigenas-y-afromexicanos-es-un-acto-de-justicia-social/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-02-21 | AMLO presented the Indigenous and Afro-Mexican reform as a rights reform, recognizing these communities as subjects of public rights with self-determination, legal personality, and patrimony. This is strong positive evidence for dignity and equal standing, not just aggregate welfare. | IDs: 6B.8, 6B.3
- [`Estrategia nacional de protección para las mujeres y las niñas con un solo objetivo, que todas se sientan libres y sin miedo`](https://www.gob.mx/conavim/prensa/estrategia-nacional-de-proteccion-para-las-mujeres-y-las-ninas-con-un-solo-objetivo-que-todas-se-sientan-libres-y-sin-miedo-segob-371930?idiom=es) | Segob / CONAVIM | 2024-07-25 | The government framed gender-violence policy as going to territories, not just offices, and tied it to prevention, housing credits, and expanded local capacity. This supports a genuine dignity-centered approach for women and girls. | IDs: 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.5
- [`Se refuerza estrategia contra la violencia hacia las mujeres y niñas: SSPC`](https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/se-refuerza-estrategia-contra-la-violencia-hacia-las-mujeres-y-ninas-sspc) | SSPC | 2024-08-06 | SSPC reported broad outreach, training for public servants and police, and a claimed feminicide decline. Even if the performance claim is official, the policy focus is explicitly about safety, respect, and equal civic standing for women and girls. | IDs: 6B.8, 6B.3
- [`La escuela es nuestra alcanza cobertura del 99 por ciento en planteles de educación básica`](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/la-escuela-es-nuestra-alcanza-cobertura-del-99-por-ciento-en-planteles-de-educacion-basica/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-06-26 | The school program used direct funding through parent committees, which is an equality-oriented delivery design that reduces hierarchy and local gatekeeping. That is evidence for equal opportunity in access to schooling, not just spending volume. | IDs: 6B.8, 6B.5, 6B.4
- [`Programa IMSS-Bienestar del Seguro Social atiende a casi 4 millones de indígenas con respeto a usos y costumbres`](https://www.gob.mx/imss/prensa/programa-imss-bienestar-del-seguro-social-atiende-a-casi-4-millones-de-indigenas-con-respeto-a-usos-y-costumbres) | IMSS | 2024-08-09 | IMSS-Bienestar said it served nearly 4 million Indigenous people, with free medicines and some staff speaking Indigenous languages. That is strong evidence of targeted dignity-sensitive service delivery for a marginalized group. | IDs: 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.4
- [`Ninguna forma de discriminación racial debe existir`](https://www.gob.mx/segob/prensa/ninguna-forma-de-discriminacion-racial-debe-existir?idiom=en) | SEGOB / CONAPRED | 2024-03-21 | The government itself acknowledged racial profiling, arbitrary detentions, invisibility of Afro-Mexicans, and barriers to identity documents for Indigenous, migrant, and ethnic-minority people. This is direct negative evidence that dignity and equal opportunity were not reliably protected in practice. | IDs: 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.7
- [`Recomendaciones de política para prestar servicios de salud sin discriminación...`](https://sindis.conapred.gob.mx/investigaciones/recomendaciones-de-politica-para-prestar-servicios-de-salud-sin-discriminacion-y-fortalecer-el-modelo-intercultural-de-atencion-a-la-salud-y-entornos-saludables-de-pueblos-indigenas-y-afrodescendiente/) | CONAPRED | 2024 | CONAPRED’s 2024 policy work explicitly describes discriminatory, unequal, and unjust treatment of Indigenous and Afrodescendant people in health services. That undercuts a clean equal-opportunity claim because access was still shaped by prejudice and exclusion. | IDs: 6B.8, 6B.2, 6B.3
- [`Pobreza infantil y adolescente en México-2022`](https://www.unicef.org/mexico/informes/pobreza-infantil-y-adolescente-en-m%C3%A9xico-2022) | UNICEF | 2024-10 | UNICEF found that while poverty fell overall, Indigenous children remained in especially severe poverty and the southeast lagged far behind the northwest. That is mixed evidence at best for equal opportunity, because structural gaps remained large. | IDs: 6B.8, 6B.2, 6B.3
- [`World Report 2024: Mexico`](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | HRW reported migrants and asylum seekers are preyed upon, checkpoints disproportionately affect Indigenous and Afro-Mexican people, and women with disabilities face disproportionate violence. This is strong negative evidence against a consistent dignity-first state. | IDs: 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.6
- [`Digital News Report 2024: Mexico`](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico) | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | The Reuters Institute described AMLO’s final year as marked by continued verbal attacks on journalists, human-rights advocates, and the media. That is negative evidence for dignity, because it treats critics as targets rather than equal participants. | IDs: 6B.8, 6B.7
- [`Mexico City police arrest 2 journalists at human rights protest`](https://cpj.org/2024/09/mexico-city-police-arrest-2-journalists-at-human-rights-protest/) | Committee to Protect Journalists | 2024-09-09 | Police beat and arrested journalists covering a protest. This is concrete evidence of unequal treatment of scrutiny and dissent, cutting directly against dignity and equal civic standing. | IDs: 6B.8, 6B.7, 6B.3
- [`Mexico: military’s role in migrant massacre comes under sharp scrutiny`](https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-militarys-role-in-migrant-massacre-comes-under-sharp-scrutiny-2024-10-16/) | Reuters | 2024-10-16 | Reuters reported soldiers killed six migrants and the military’s account was disputed locally. That is severe negative evidence on equal dignity for a vulnerable out-group. | IDs: 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.6

**Search Gap**
- The strongest positives are rights reforms, equality-oriented programs, and more inclusive service design.
- The strongest negatives are independent reports of ongoing discrimination and abuse against Indigenous people, migrants, women with disabilities, journalists, and protesters.
- I did not find strong independent 2024 evidence that AMLO systematically narrowed dignity gaps across society; most positive evidence is legal or programmatic, while the outcome evidence remains uneven and often self-reported.
